title: Ansel and the Safehouse
author: Ines Villalobos
blurb: Paloma Pemberton, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
